title: Appointment, independence and connected conduct: forensic inquiry control
purpose: Test appointment eligibility, required disclosures, dated relationships and particular subsequent acts through source-graded, actor-specific analysis beginning before nomination and acceptance. No incompatibility, unlawful coordination or responsibility is established by this interface.
canonical_boundary: Selection and identity do not establish relationship, knowledge, authority, participation or liability. Reconcile unresolved source mentions with existing registers; do not create duplicate actors or proceedings.
temporal_rule: Do not treat a later notice date as the beginning of knowledge without reconciling earlier sources. Distinguish source creation, transmission, reply and actual notice. Pre-appointment conflict is a separately tested hypothesis.
privacy: The full working registry, source locators, private correspondence and legal strategy remain in restricted custody. This interface deliberately contains no private provider IDs, contacts, source bodies or confidential storage URLs.
release_boundary: This working-branch file is not a merge, deployment, court filing, evidential admission, external communication or finding. Existing legal, source, privacy and release gates remain unchanged.
